description:
[writes · `write` scope, or `ads:manage`] Hides one attention row (`alertId` from ads_attention_list) for a while. Fixes nothing: only dismiss a row the user has dealt with or asked to hide. Moves no money and changes nothing on the ad network.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/attention/{alertId}/dismiss.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key is pinned to its brand and any other value is 403.

name: ads_attention_dismiss
title: Dismiss an ads attention row
